name: Seth
overview: Seth, the third son of Adam and Eve, is introduced in Scripture as the divinely appointed replacement for Abel, whom Cain had slain, emphasizing God's providential care in preserving the godly lineage (Genesis 4:25). Known also as Sheth or Sheth, his birth marks a significant moment as his son Enos is noted as the time when people began to call upon the name of the LORD, highlighting a renewed focus on worship and dependence on God (Genesis 4:26). Seth's genealogy underscores the continuation of God's image in humanity, as Adam fathered him in his likeness, and Seth lived a long life, ultimately dying at 912 years, showing the early biblical emphasis on longevity and lineage (Genesis 5:3-4, 8).
